{"consolidated_memory":"**Infinite recursion issues in graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine)**

Two separate incidents with the same symptom but different root causes:

**Incident 1 [2026-01-19]:**
- File: graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Problem: infinite recursion in the walker
- Reproduction: walk the cyclic fixture graph
- Signal: stack grows until guard trips
- Trigger: occurred only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #9151 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1
- Result: job runtime improved from 2 hours to 24 minutes
- Stack/Language: Rust
- Covering test: module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs

**Incident 2 [2026-08-18]:**
- File: graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Problem: infinite recursion in the walker
- Reproduction: walk the cyclic fixture graph
- Signal: stack grows until guard trips
- Trigger: occurred only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed on teardown
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #9927 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-2
- Result: flaky test failures reduced from 49 per hundred runs to zero
- Stack/Language: Rust
- Covering test: module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs"}
